name: Angola
summary: Red over black with a golden emblem of a half cog-wheel, a machete and a star. Based on the flag of the MPLA liberation movement, it was adopted at independence from Portugal in 1975.
origin: The People's Movement for the Liberation of Angola (MPLA) used a red and black flag with a yellow star during the war of independence against Portugal.

At independence on 11 November 1975 the MPLA government added the emblem of a cog-wheel and machete, deliberately echoing the Soviet hammer and sickle. A new flag was proposed in 2003 but never adopted.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: The blood shed during the colonial period and the war of independence.
